svg.title: Record and restore the software environment
svg.desc: R uses rig for its language version and renv for packages; renv.lock records both. Python uses uv with .python-version, pyproject.toml and uv.lock. The agent restores the recorded setup separately and compares a selected output without changing the current working environment.
svg.text: Save both language and package versions

svg.text: The agent restores the saved setup
The current working environment stays unchanged
